name: Process editor
description: A catalog of processes (processes) with their recipes: read, change by hand or in words, build your own, try them, run them by hand and from automations.

permissions.processes:register: Saves the processes you make and your own versions of plugins' processes as files in plugins/my-processes.
permissions.processes:run: Moves a task to the new version of its process when you ask, and runs trials of a process.
permissions.agents:spawn: Runs the agent that changes a process when you say what to change.
permissions.tasks:write: Makes the tasks of trial runs and deletes them after a day, unless you keep them.
